title: YOUR UPDATE HAS FAILED
subtitle: PC Simulator · SurvivingSOGICE · University of Bergen, Center for Digital Narrative
premise: You will follow different lives through thirty years of one machine.
about: You sit at one computer in one room. The room ages around you, and the software keeps updating. What the software is for is the thing you are here to see.
contentNote: This depicts how organised "conversion" networks target queer people online — in their own tactics and language. You can leave at any time; nothing you do is kept.
controlsDesktopLines: Drag with the mouse to look around the room.
Click to choose, and to use things on the desk.
Click a marker on the floor to move to it.
Esc — or the corner button — opens the menu: pause, controls, credits, leave.
controlsHeadsetLines: Turn your head to look around the room.
Point with the controller and pull the trigger to choose.
Point at a marker on the floor and pull the trigger to move to it.
The menu button opens the same menu: pause, controls, credits, leave.
controlsPhoneLines: Turn the device to look around the room, as you would in a 360 video.
Or drag with one finger, if you would rather not move.
Tap to choose. A tap that slides is a look, not a choice.
Pinch to zoom in when something is too small to read.
Landscape shows the whole screen at once; upright works too.
controlsNote: You never walk, and nothing here is timed. Turning to look is the only thing your body has to do.
enterNote: The room is dark until you do.
